title: Okta directory adapter and account sync
name: Directory sync adapter

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how the adapter translates the provider's data into the application's domain model? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A sync run is in the middle of pagination when the access token expires and the provider answers 401. What does _request do?
choices: Raises immediately, aborting the sync run
Drops the cached token and retries the same request, which fetches a new token via _access_token, as long as attempts remain
Retries with the same expired token after sleeping
Restarts pagination from the first page with a new token

questions.prompt: The sync loops over store.known_external_ids() - seen and calls get_user for each. What does this second pass accomplish, and what is its cost?
choices: It re-syncs active users that failed in the first pass, at the cost of duplicate upserts
It is only a safety net for rate limiting and normally does nothing
It validates every account's groups, at the cost of one API call per account
It detects accounts that disappeared from the listing and disables them, at the cost of one extra API call per missing account

questions.prompt: requests raises a RequestException when the directory times out during a listing. How does the caller of iter_users see this?
choices: A DirectoryUnavailable is raised after the final attempt, and users already yielded to the sync have been processed
The raw RequestException propagates after the final attempt
An empty list is returned and the sync treats all stored accounts as missing
The generator swallows the error and ends iteration cleanly
